title: Miso-Glazed Roasted Aubergine with Rice
summary: A vegan Japanese-inspired dinner of tender roasted aubergine brushed with a sweet-savoury miso glaze, served over fluffy white rice. It is comforting, umami-rich and easy enough for a weeknight.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear, then cook according to packet instructions until tender and fluffy; keep warm.

Score the cut sides of the aubergines in a shallow criss-cross pattern, taking care not to cut through the skin. Place them cut-side up on a baking tray, brush with the vegetable oil and season with a pinch of salt.
Roast the aubergines for 25 minutes, until the flesh is soft and starting to turn golden at the edges.
Meanwhile, mix the miso, tamari, maple syrup, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic and sesame oil in a small bowl to make a smooth glaze.
Brush the glaze generously over the roasted aubergine flesh. Return to the oven for 8–10 minutes, until the glaze is glossy, bubbling and lightly caramelised.
Spoon the rice into bowls, top with the miso-glazed aubergine, and scatter over sesame seeds and sliced spring onions before serving.
